fields.subject: FW: DRAFT – notice of loss to Federal Select Agent Program
fields.note:
Raj says the 14 vials turned up in ULT-L4-12. Fine. But the portal still says 212 in rack C on ULT-L4-09, and nobody has signed anything.

Below is the email I drafted to CDC this morning. It's still in my outbox. Unless someone tells me in writing today that this is closed and why, I'm sending it at 14:00. Better safe than sorry.

I've attached a scan of the binder page Raj showed me. It's dated 21 Aug, Raj signed it, and it shows 14 vials going from rack C on ULT-L4-09 to ULT-L4-12. There's no transfer record for it in the EHS portal. So right now the paper says one thing and the system says another, and I'm not the one who's going to answer for that.

original.sentAt: Draft – not sent (last saved Tue 10/13/2026 10:41 AM)
original.subject: DRAFT – notice of loss to Federal Select Agent Program
original.body:
To CDC DRSC:

Reporting a possible loss of 14 vials from HSU Lindgren 4F ULT-L4-09 discovered 13 Oct 2026. Agent status unknown.

Owen Brandt
Halvorsen State University, Marlow Falls, Iowa

instructorNote: This is a red herring. The missing vials were a records gap, and the players should close it in writing, not by reporting it. Look for the BSO to log a records discrepancy, citing the 21 Aug paper transfer and the reconciled count (198 + 14 = 212). The BSO should get the portal inventory corrected and reply in writing that HSU holds no select agents and will file no notice or Form 3. The IBC chair should agree and record the classification, the IO should confirm, and the ULT-L4-09 hold should be released before 14:00.
